dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Meige syndrome (idiopathic segmental cranial dystonia involving blepharospasm and oromandibular dystonia), likely due to basal ganglia dysfunction with no structural lesion on imaging.

Alternatives to still consider:
1. Tardive orofacial dyskinesia from an undisclosed dopamine antagonist (e.g., metoclopramide, prochlorperazine, or a herbal/traditional remedy)
2. Functional (psychogenic) facial movement disorder
3. Brainstem-localised facial myokymia below the resolution of the MRI performed
